top_signals.title: Stocks, Bonds Waver Ahead of Warsh Speech | Bloomberg Brief 08/28/2026
top_signals.summary: US equity futures drag as investors await Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's speech at the Jackson Hole Economic Symposium to look for clues on the central bank's outlook and strategy on inflation. Shares of Nvidia drag in pre-market trading after adding $442 billion in value in a day, its second-biggest daily gain on record. Paypal extends its decline as Advent and Stripe are said to have pulled out their $50 billion buyout bid. Venezuela is reportedly weighing an exit from OPEC in discussions with US officials. Sitara Sundar of JPM Private Bank looks ahead to Chair Warsh's remarks.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Pakistan’s Five Refineries Set for $6 Billion Upgrade Push
top_signals.summary: Pakistan’s five oil refineries are expected to sign agreements in early September for upgrades that are expected to unlock as much as $6 billion in investment in the country’s refining sector. Representatives of the five refineries, Pak Arab Refinery Limited (PARCO), Pakistan Refinery Limited (PRL), National Refinery Limited (NRL), Cnergyico, and Attock Refinery Limited (ARL), have met with Pakistan’s Federal Minister for Petroleum, Ali Pervaiz Malik, to discuss the so-called Refinery Upgradation Policy, local daily Business Recorder…
